categories.title: Boss
categories.info: Extra-tough ghost characters that are fought on every floor of The Last Resort. Will usually drop an Elevator Button to explore more of the hotel.

categories.title: Elevator Button
categories.info: Buttons dropped by bosses that allow Luigi to explore a new floor of The Last Resort.

categories.title: Gooigi Grate
categories.info: Gooigi Grates are green pipes that can be used by Gooigi to take him to a different part of the current room. Most are double-ended, but some are one-way affairs.

categories.title: Locked Door
categories.info: A door that typically requires a Key in order to unlock.

categories.title: Boo
categories.info: Boos appear on floors where you've found the Elevator Button, and only in specific rooms. Your controller will pulse when close to the door to where a Boo is hiding, and vibrate when close to the object. If you check the wrong object, the Boo will move to a different room.

categories.title: Gem
categories.info: Gemstones that Luigi can find and collect, and viewable in The Lab. There's six Gemstones on each floor of the hotel, except the top floor.

categories.title: Key
categories.info: Keys are used to unlock Locked Doors. Due to the game design, you almost never encounter more than one Key at a time.

categories.title: Treasure
categories.info: A source of money. The amount of money you have determines the ending: the maximum requirement for the best ending is 70,000.

categories.title: Golden Mouse
categories.info: A gold mouse that can be flashed with the Strobulb to release a LOT of treasure.

categories.title: Golden Spider
categories.info: A gold spider that can be flashed with the Strobulb to release a LOT of treasure.

categories.title: Hidden Object
categories.info: An invisible object that can be revealed with the Dark-Light. It will still cast shadows, and be visible in mirrors.

categories.title: Portal
categories.info: Portals are used to jump from one location to another, but must be activated on one end. Unlike with Doors, Luigi can carry objects through a Portal using the Poltergust.

categories.title: Portrait
categories.info: Portraits will contain one of Luigi's trapped friends, who can be freed by shining the Dark-Light on them.
